name: Janusz Lewandowski - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT on the proposal for a decision of the European Parliament and of the Council on the mobilisation of the European Globalisation Adjustment Fund for Displaced Workers following an application from Belgium - EGF/2024/003 BE/Van Hool
part_text:
The European Parliament approves giving Belgium 7,999,015 euros from the European Globalisation Adjustment Fund. The money helps 2,397 former workers of bus and coach maker Van Hool, which went bankrupt in April 2024. The fund pays 85 percent of a 9.4 million euro support package. The money covers job search help, career guidance, retraining, workplace training and digital skills courses. Many of the workers are over 50 or have low qualifications, so the support focuses on learning new skills.

- Belgium receives 7,999,015 euros to help 2,397 former Van Hool workers find new jobs.
- The workers get job search help, guidance, retraining and digital skills training.
- Belgium runs the services; the money is paid from the European Union budget.
